name: oh-my-agent-mod
description: oh-my-agent (/oma): one router session that never builds. It writes tickets with you, hands each to a worker in its own git worktree, has a tester and reviewer check it, merges it, walks it in Claude Code's built-in browser and fixes small bugs, coming to you only for decisions. Sets each project up on first /oma, replaces superpowers, and works alongside oh-my-context (omc).

review_tickets.title: Review tickets before building
review_tickets.description: Blank (default): tickets the router writes are built straight away; you are asked only about choices that change what users see. Set to true to keep new tickets as draft until you approve them.

keep_superpowers.title: Keep superpowers on
keep_superpowers.description: Blank (default): oh-my-agent turns the superpowers plugin off once, since /oma replaces it (/oma restore-superpowers undoes it, and a plugin you turn back on yourself stays on). Set to true to never touch it.
